up: Find all approved drugs that have an indication for schizophrenia. Use the drug_indication table to get indications with max_phase_for_ind = 4 (indicating approval for that indication). The schizophrenia indication can be identified by mesh_heading = 'Schizophrenia' or efo_term = 'schizophrenia' (case-insensitive matching on efo_term). For each such drug, retrieve its ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), its SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles, using a LEFT JOIN to retain drugs without SMILES), the EFO ID (drug_indication.efo_id), the indication label (drug_indication.efo_term), and the maximum phase for indication (drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind). Ensure each drug appears only once, even if multiple indication rows match. Do not impose any row limit; return all qualifying drugs.
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.efo_id, di.efo_term, di.max_phase_for_ind, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY md.molregno ORDER BY di.efo_id) AS rn FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE di.max_phase_for_ind = 4 AND (di.mesh_heading = 'Schizophrenia' OR LOWER(di.efo_term) = 'schizophrenia')) SELECT chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id, efo_term, max_phase_for_ind FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY chembl_id

up: Find all approved drugs indicated for schizophrenia. Approved drugs are those that have been approved for the specific indication, identified by max_phase_for_ind = 4 in the drug_indication table. The schizophrenia indication can be identified by mesh_heading = 'Schizophrenia' or by a case‑insensitive match on efo_term = 'schizophrenia'. For each such drug, provide: the ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), drug name (pref_name), SMILES (canonical_smiles from compound_structures; include drugs even if SMILES are missing by using a left join), EFO ID (efo_id), indication label (efo_term), and max phase for indication (max_phase_for_ind). Ensure each drug appears only once (use distinct on the requested columns). Do not limit the number of rows; return all qualifying drugs. Optionally order by ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.efo_id, di.efo_term, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE di.max_phase_for_ind = 4 AND (di.mesh_heading = 'Schizophrenia' OR LOWER(di.efo_term) = 'schizophrenia') ORDER BY md.chembl_id;
